_readme: Copy to llm.json. The trading model is Bonsai 2 27B (prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf) served by the PrismML llama.cpp fork: start it with Start-LLM.bat (port 8080). Test with: python -m llm ping. reasoning_effort: none (default, fastest; the decision has seconds), medium (thinks ~2k tokens: then max_tokens 16384) - never low/high (not supported / HTTP 500). Sampling = the model card's non-thinking values.
